Meet your next racquet.

Build your doubles attack from the rear court. The Astrox 88D Tour pairs a stiff shaft with a frame designed around powerful, decisive shots. Its 2G-Namd FLEX FORCE shaft material supports responsive recovery between swings, making it a natural option for players who enjoy driving the rally with clears and steep attacking shots.
